Definition: Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Meribah is the place of strife, named for the water where Israel strove with God. Exodus 17:7 says Moses called the place Massah and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD. Numbers 20:13 says, This is the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and Deuteronomy 33:8 recalls that Levi's holy one was proved at Massah and striven with at the waters of Meribah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Meribah is the name of a place no one should want to revisit: the water came, and the striving is what the place is remembered for. My position is that God gives water even to a striving people, and the mercy is greater than the name.
